label: Week 7
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
volume_note: Week volume is the sum of nightly volumes; all 7 nights have counts for all 32 clubs. ATL volume is inflated by a throwback-logo meme on 2026-10-24 that the nightly filter dropped, so its loud-room topics come only from kept items.
headline: Week 7 ran loudest in Philadelphia, where Jalen Hurts' season-ending lung blood clots, a fourth straight loss to Carolina and Saquon Barkley's return to practice dominated the room. Dallas (2-4 after Lambeau, Schottenheimer defending his play-calling before Monday night in Philly) and Chicago (Caleb Williams back to beat Atlanta, then Santos' 58-yarder to top New England on Thursday, plus the Herbstreit backlash) were close behind, with New England, AFC North-leading Cleveland and Buffalo's suspension saga next. Unbeaten San Francisco's receiver injury wave, Green Bay's Jacobs return, Atlanta's Dalton signing and Pittsburgh's Paris trip filled out the loud rooms, while Indianapolis fired GM Chris Ballard and opened the trade-deadline talk. All seven nights logged with counts for all 32 clubs. Vibe only.
